summary: The code is syntactically valid and imports standard libraries correctly, but the simulation is incomplete and will fail at runtime. Core methods (run, step, visualize, save_results, validate) are missing, the infection module is unfinished, and required behaviors/metrics from the specification are not implemented. Although main() is correctly called at global scope, the implementation does not meet the functional requirements.

issues.description: Missing core Simulation methods: run, step, visualize, save_results, and validate, which are referenced in main(). This causes immediate runtime errors.
issues.solution: Implement Simulation.run(days), Simulation.step(day), Simulation.visualize(), Simulation.save_results(path), and Simulation.validate(num_runs, days). Ensure these methods handle daily state updates, metrics accumulation, plotting (optional), CSV writing, and Monte Carlo validation.

issues.description: The infection simulation is incomplete. _simulate_infections ends mid-calculation and does not update infection states or metrics coherently.
issues.solution: Complete the infection model by calculating effective transmission probabilities (including mask efficacy), simulating new infections, updating health_status (S->I->R) with counters, and recording daily_new_infections and Rt. Use avg_mask_factor and contact structures or a simplified mixing model to generate new cases.

issues.description: The code does not implement the specified interactions and behaviors (social_influence_on_adoption, visit_and_contact_at_location, policy_enforcement, mask_purchase, information_diffusion, policy_adjustment_feedback) nor the detailed agent behaviors required by the task.
issues.solution: In Simulation.step(day), implement: (1) media/information broadcast and peer influence updating risk perception; (2) household norm updates; (3) person decisions to adopt/drop mask; (4) retailer restocking, purchasing logic, and policy-driven allocations; (5) visit and contact generation at Locations with enforcement; (6) policy adjustments; (7) infection transmission; (8) metrics updating.

issues.description: Social influence and risk perception functions exist (Person.perceive_risk, SocialNetwork.propagate_social_influence) but are never invoked. Household norms are not updated daily.
issues.solution: Within step(day), compute adopted_prev, apply SocialNetwork.propagate_social_influence or _peer_share per agent, call Person.perceive_risk with proper weights, and update Household.update_norm using prior-day adoption.

issues.description: Required metrics from the spec are not computed or exposed: adoption_rate_over_time, time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption_rate, average_compliance_in_contacts, adoption_by_group, policy_effect_size, supply_shortage_days, adoption_inequality_index.
issues.solution: Track daily adoption rate, compute 50% crossing day, max adoption, contact compliance in Location interactions, stratify adoption by groups (age, SES, region/household), compute DiD-like policy effect, count days with shortages (demand > inventory), and compute inequality via gini or Theil across groups.

issues.description: Policy enforcement is defined at the Location level, but mandates are never activated/deactivated in the daily flow and enforcement is not consumed against capacity or costs.
issues.location: PolicyAuthority.issue_mandates is unused; Location.enforce_mask_policy only called hypothetically
issues.solution: In step(day), determine mandate status via policy.issue_mandates, set policy_requires_mask on eligible locations, adjust enforcement_level via adjust_enforcement, and apply enforce_mask_policy during visits. Track incidents, penalties, and costs.

issues.description: main() calls methods that do not exist (run, visualize, save_results, validate) causing AttributeError at runtime.
issues.solution: Implement the missing methods or guard calls with availability checks. Ideally, complete implementation so these calls succeed.

issues.description: Scale-free generation uses a growing 'targets' list for preferential attachment. For very large populations, this can be memory/time intensive.
issues.solution: Consider using degree-sum sampling (alias method or cumulative degree array) to sample attachment targets in O(1) amortized time without maintaining a long 'targets' list.

issues.description: Validation criteria (monotonic_policy_response, steady_state_stability, stochastic_convergence, empirical_fit_optional) are not implemented. validate() is missing.
issues.solution: Implement a validate method that runs multiple simulations across policy strengths, checks steady-state stability in last 14 days, computes standard deviation across final adoption rates for Monte Carlo runs, and optionally RMSE vs observed time series.

issues.description: Some entities differ in naming and attributes from the spec (PolicyAuthority vs PolicyMaker; MediaChannel/InformationChannel vs InformationSource), and missing behaviors like broadcast_local_signals and host_visits_and_contacts.
issues.solution: Align class names/attributes/behaviors more closely with the specification, or provide adapters/shims so required behaviors are present and used in the simulation loop.
